phase_reset: each benchmark and phase independently starts from cash 1 and no shares; final open liquidates
prices: SPY observed open and dividends; no adjusted prices or repeated split adjustment

spy.entry: fixed shares = initial capital / ((1 + execution_bps/10000) * first observed open)
spy.funding: entry principal plus entry fee consume initial capital; no financing beyond floating-point roundoff
spy.holding: fixed fractional shares until final open; no daily/monthly rebalancing
spy.dividends: old shares times current dividend enter cash; initial ex-date purchases get no dividend
spy.cash_interest: max(previous cash, 0) times exported same-interval RF return
spy.interest_timing: new dividends start earning interest in the next interval, not the interval just ended
spy.liquidation: sell all fixed shares at final observed open; credit old-share dividend, interest and subtract exit fee

cash.interest: cash_previous plus cash_previous times exported interval RF return

accounting: NAV = cash + shares * observed open; price PnL, signed dividends, cash interest and fees counted once
borrow: no short positions or borrowing fees in either benchmark

statistics.daily_return: current NAV_post / previous NAV_post - 1; first real interval uses initial capital 1
statistics.initial_open: no zero-length daily return; initial entry fee included in first real interval
statistics.cash_excess: net daily return minus same-interval exported RF return
statistics.sharpe: sqrt(252) * mean(cash excess) / sample std(ddof=1); N/A if std <= zero tolerance
statistics.turnover: two-sided actual trade notional/NAV_pre summed and annualized by 252/holding_intervals; no half factor

comparison: use saved step-11 strategies; identical endpoints/intervals and capital; no strategy replay
interpretation: SPY is fully invested market exposure; paired strategies have different exposure; these are investable alternatives, not risk-matched portfolios

evidence_boundary.validation: already used for model and threshold selection; reused evaluation is tuning evidence
evidence_boundary.test: fixed-rule test-period strategy evaluation, not an untouched blind holdout
evidence_boundary.gbdt_provenance: Exploratory grid; previous project test results already known
evidence_boundary.training_oof: retrospective training-only signal-scale diagnostic; not an alternative official model
evidence_boundary.freeze_timing: frozen now before step-11 test portfolio replay; not a retrospective claim of freezing before earlier model exploration
